extracted.name: Artichoke Bruschetta
extracted.description: This is a great bruschetta recipe based on an artichoke dip. It's always a huge hit! Try adding spinach or tomatoes!
ingredient_lines: 1 (6.5 ounce) jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1 French baguette, cut into 1/3 inch thick slices
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, mix marinated artichoke hearts, Romano cheese, red onion and mayonnaise. Top French baguette slices with equal amounts of the artichoke heart mixture. Arrange slices in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Broil in the preheated oven 2 minutes, or until toppings are bubbly and lightly browned.
